name: Egypt
wdpa_release: WDPA/WD-OECM October 2026 (Protected Planet; UNEP-WCMC map service)
pame_transfer_note: BREMi evaluations of the Omayed and Wadi Allaqi biosphere reserves moved to El Omayed (12359) and Wadi Al Alaqi (14895); IBA monitoring of the Wadi El Rayan Ramsar site moved to Wadi El Rayan protected area (30006), the same physical site. The Wadi Al-Hitan World Heritage Outlook stays on its record: the site is only part of Wadi El Rayan.
boundary_note: Land = geoBoundaries EGY ADM0 minus the Halaib Triangle (overlap with geoBoundaries SDN, 18,042 km²); sea = Marine Regions EEZ v12 'Egyptian EEZ' (Halaib and Egypt/Libya overlapping-claim waters not counted), as in Protected Planet. KBA Gebel Elba (entirely in Halaib) set aside.
